Chinese stocks may extend their gains in the second half of the year as resilient exports and recovering producer prices support economic growth while disruption from high oil prices fades, according to brokerages at home and abroad.
Average full-year earnings growth for mainland-listed companies could accelerate to 10 per cent on the strength of the economy, while households could channel 2 trillion yuan (US$294 billion) into equities, according to Guosen Securities. Founder Securities made a...
text_zh: 中外券商认为，中国股市下半年有望延续涨势，因韧性出口与回温的生产者价格支撑经济增长，同时高油价冲击逐渐消退。得益于经济基本面强劲，A股上市公司全年平均盈利增速或加快至10%。
